principle: Asset-specific verification; no universal bridge committee and no single operator.

CADC.verification: LayerZero Endpoint V2 + issuer-peered OFT/OFTAdapter + multi-DVN security stack
CADC.minimum: At least 2 required independent DVNs; higher-value path should consider 2-of-3 or 3-of-N.

USDC.verification: Circle MessageTransmitterV2 validates Iris-signed attestation; TokenMessengerV2 burn/mint
USDC.fallback: If 420 is not CCTP-supported at genesis, keep USDC route inactive rather than deploy an unofficial canonical USDC bridge.

ETH.verification: Verify finalized source-chain state/event inclusion on 420; avoid wrapped ETH backed solely by multisig.
ETH.fallback: Diverse threshold verifier/DVN path with strict caps only for testnet/early limited value.

BTC.verification: Verify PoW header chain and deposit inclusion; withdrawal custody remains a separate hard problem.
BTC.activation: APPROVED_INACTIVE until custody/withdrawal mechanism passes dedicated review.

global_controls: no bridge verifier controlled by the 420 validator committee solely by virtue of validator status
